## Description
A clear and concise description of what happened.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Environment
- **App Version:** (e.g. `v0.2.3-beta`)
- **OS & Architecture:** (e.g. Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, Windows 11 x64, macOS arm64)
- **Package Type:** (`.AppImage` / `.exe` setup / `.exe` portable / `.dmg` / `npm run dev`)
- **XRPL Network:** (`mainnet` / `testnet` / `devnet` / `custom`)

## Diagnostics / Logs
If helpful, attach a **redacted** diagnostics bundle exported from `Analytics & Tray → Export Redacted Diagnostics` (never paste seeds, passphrases, or private keys).
